content: Orchestration-based saga: a coordinator (often embedded in order-service) issues commands to participants (inventory, payment, shipping) and drives compensating actions on failure (e.g. release reservation, cancel order). Choreography relies on services reacting to each other's events with no central coordinator. Orchestration is easier to reason about and debug for a small saga (2-3 participants), which fits a portfolio project; choreography scales better organizationally but is harder to trace end-to-end.
